name: Saiga Rei
source:
Born with the ability to read people’s thoughts and emotions by touching them, though he can only use this ability once a day before running out of energy. This strange ability causes him to be rejected by his parents, so as a child he was raised by Kujo Takami's father, a distant relative.

[Edited from [url=http://aarinfantasy.com/forum/f16/t74083-review-of-rashiel%27s-riddle.html]Aarinfantasy Forums[/url]]
